description: OL W1c·S3 — H1 with the lane on, and a reply that invents a member. The query narrows the account by a name nothing in the question, the bindings or the values says — upper-cased, the form review-329 R1 showed slipping past a column-only rule. The checks refuse it before the door: QUERY_NOT_WRITTEN with the lattice and the broken rule, no repair (the door never saw it), no rows.
invariants: the lane is what emit does when it is on; the verdicts do not change and nothing in it binds (OL-C11)
the door runs the query under the CALLER's subject, whoever wrote it (OL-C12)
a refusal is not an error: it carries the lattice and the last error
a query the checks refused is never sent, and never repaired (OL-C16)
never rows from a query the checks refused

args.text: Zobraz náklady účtu 501001 v roce 2025 podle období

replies.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) AS obdobi, SUM(e.amount) AS naklady FROM er.entity.cost_entry e JOIN er.entity.account a ON e.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.code = '501001' AND UPPER(a.name) = 'SPOTŘEBA MATERIÁLU' AND e.booked_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND e.booked_on < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) ORDER BY obdobi
